body: One measured constraint on the A/B ruling: RecallParaphrase supplies one target vector per whole statement, not per clause. Removing the merge cannot honestly assign gold to each production unit without new annotations; copying the statement targets onto every clause would invent evidence. My narrow preference is therefore A: rename the helper as an explicit statement-level acceptance adapter, document that it diverges from production clause grain, and add a capacity-to-fail test proving at least one paraphrase is multi-unit in production but exactly one unit in the diagnostic. I will follow your ruling, and will not create public policy/vocabulary in this slice.
